title: Artifact Manifest
description: Control B (provenance identity) manifest for a governed evidence artifact. A manifest identifies an artifact; it does not by itself establish storage immutability (Control A) or workflow eligibility (Control C).

artifact_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this artifact.

challenge_id.description: The challenge this artifact belongs to, e.g. 'challenge-01'.

artifact_role.description: The artifact's governed role. Determines whether it can carry evidentiary or consequence authority.

designated_authority.description: The human/system authority responsible for the determination. Never an AI model on its own.

source_author.description: Who produced the artifact bytes. May note AI assistance, which does not transfer authority.

created_at.description: When the artifact was created (RFC 3339 date-time), or null if unknown/not applicable.

received_at.description: When this repository/custodian received the artifact, or null.

frozen_at.description: When the artifact was frozen (RFC 3339 date-time). Required once status is FROZEN; otherwise may be null.

sha256.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the frozen bytes. Required once status is FROZEN; null when NOT_PRESENT. Never fabricated.

version.description: Version of this artifact. Corrections increment the version or supersede.

status.description: Lifecycle status. NOT_PRESENT is a first-class truthful status for genuinely absent artifacts.

exposure_state.description: Cross-exposure state. POST_CROSS_EXPOSURE can never be relabeled PRE_CROSS_EXPOSURE.

supersedes.description: artifact_id that this artifact supersedes, or null.

source_artifact_refs.description: artifact_ids this artifact references, e.g. the issuer artifact a determination was based on.

artifact_file_ref.description: Repo-relative path of the file whose exact bytes sha256 covers. Binds the hash to specific content (non-substitution). Null when NOT_PRESENT or when a bundle-of-hashes method is described in the provenance record.

notes.description: Free-text notes. Must not contain protected information (see GOVERNANCE.md).

ai_assistance.description: Optional, non-authority-granting record of AI involvement in producing this artifact.

role.description: e.g. 'draft', 'summary', 'narration'. Never authority-bearing unless adopted via governance.

adopted_by.description: designated_authority who explicitly adopted AI output, or null if not adopted. Informational only on a non_authoritative_summary; never elevates the artifact's role by itself (see GOVERNANCE.md §6).

adoption_record_ref.description: Reference to the governance adoption record. Required when adopted_by is non-null.

allOf.comment: FROZEN artifacts must carry a freeze timestamp and a real hash.
SUPERSEDED artifacts were previously frozen; their frozen_at and hash are retained unchanged (non-destructive supersession, PROVENANCE_RULES.md §5).
Any artifact with a non-null frozen_at must carry a real hash (e.g. WITHDRAWN of a frozen artifact cannot drop its hash).
NOT_PRESENT artifacts have no bytes: no hash and no freeze timestamp may be fabricated.
Evidence-side and consequence-side determinations sit on the independence axis: they are PRE or POST, never NOT_APPLICABLE.
Reconciliation and final receipts are inherently produced after cross-exposure.
Issuer and governance artifacts are not on the cross-exposure axis.
